name: Commercially armoured full-size SUV
armament: None fitted; occupants fire from doors and windows
protection: Real-world type: full-size American SUVs or crew-cab pickups (Chevrolet Suburban/Tahoe, Cheyenne, Ram) armoured by civilian armouring shops to about B4-B6, with thick laminated glass and run-flat inserts; Mexico has one of the world's largest civilian armouring industries. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and larger penetrate; every launcher penetrates; sagging suspension and thick glass edges are the visual tells.
visual_notes: Generic inspired-by type, not a specific photographed vehicle
Long boxy three-row SUV body, dark-tinted thick windows with visible frame edges
Sits low on its suspension because of the armour weight; heavy-duty wheels
Civilian appearance: black, white or silver paint, chrome trim, no markings
Cartel versions sometimes have crude bolt-on plates over the doors or a cut roof hatch
